name: George Auld
role: Belfield newspaper editor and hay seller
bio: George Auld of Belfield was co-editor with Louis C. Hay of a newspaper published by the Mandan Times in 1885, and he visited Medora on business. In March 1886 he came to sell the hay he and Frank Holmes had put up, about seventy tons left of three hundred.

moments.label: Named co-editor with Louis C. Hay

mentions: The Belfield Courier, Vol 1, No. 1, is lying on our table. Louis C. Hay and Geo. Auld are editors and it is published by the Mandan Times. This latter fact is not mentioned editorially, but the earmarks of Bro. Cates' skill as a printer are as plainly man…

The following persons registered at the Northern Pacific since last issue: Geo. Auld, Belfield; J. A. Rea, J. H. Teller, Bismarck; D. O. Sweet and wife, Belfield; D. E. Stoney, Cleveland, Ohio; M. Wadsworth, F. A. Willard, Coll McClellan, City; W. Foley,…
Geo. Auld, of Belfield, was here last Friday on business.
Geo. Auld, of Belfield, was a visitor in Medora, Tuesday.
George Auld of Belfield, was in Medora Tuesday, disposing of the hay put up by himself and Frank Holmes last summer. They had about seventy tons left out of three hundred.
